whistleblowerConfig.heroText: Use this confidential channel to raise a concern, complaint or suggestion about workplace conduct, safety, financial integrity or another serious matter. Begin in your own words when you are ready; Si-Ware Employee Voice will guide you through the reporting process.
whistleblowerConfig.safetyText: Use the route that feels appropriate to you. If there is an immediate safety risk, follow the applicable local emergency and site-security procedures.

policyAcknowledgementContent.instructionText: Before continuing, carefully review the mandatory policies below and record your acknowledgement in place of the former email reply.
policyAcknowledgementContent.beforeText: Please read the mandatory Si-Ware Information Security Policy carefully. It covers information-handling policies including Computer Acceptable Use, Password, PDA/Smartphone and Remote Access, together with security awareness for your laptop, PC and mobile devices, physical security, virus protection, spyware/malware and social engineering/phishing. All Si-Ware users must know and adhere to these requirements. Confirmation is mandatory under Si-Ware security regulations.
policyAcknowledgementContent.confirmationLabel: I confirm that I have read and accepted Si-Ware Policies.
policyAcknowledgementContent.confirmationHelp: This records the current policy versions and confirmation time.
policyAcknowledgementContent.afterText: Your acknowledgement has been recorded for the current policy versions.

newSiPageContent.heroText: Start with one meaningful action, then build momentum. Your checklist, essential policies, support routes and everyday tools are all in one place.
newSiPageContent.asideText: Choose the next task that unlocks your workday. Your progress stays visible while you explore.
newSiPageContent.checklistText: Complete these essentials in your first five working days.
newSiPageContent.policiesText: These are the policies every colleague should know from day one. Links are ready to connect to your approved document repository.
newSiPageContent.toolsText: Your manager or IT will provide access. Use the dashboard Quick Launch dock once your account is active.
newSiPageContent.knowledgeText: Sessions and practical know-how from the team.
newSiPageContent.helpText: Start with the route that best matches your request. If you are unsure where to go, your manager or the People Team can help you find the right owner.
newSiPageContent.portalsText: Quick routes to the teams and services you will use most often.

firstWeekChecklist.text: Access your Si-Ware company email account through Gmail.
Enable two-step verification to strengthen the security of your company account.
Sign in to the Si-Ware Document Management System (DMS).
Review and acknowledge the Essential Si-Ware Policies before continuing with your onboarding.
Watch the full Security Awareness Training video in either English or Arabic before continuing with your onboarding tasks.
Watch the Company Portal Training Session.
Sign in to the Company Portal to complete your onboarding.
